summary.id: Makam Maulana Malik Ibrahim berada di Gresik, Jawa Timur. Maulana Malik Ibrahim dimakamkan di Gapurosukolilo, Gresik, dan sering disebut sebagai tokoh penyebar Islam paling awal dalam tradisi Wali Songo. Asal-usulnya diperdebatkan, sedangkan keterangan paling kokoh tentang dirinya berasal dari inskripsi nisan di makamnya.
summary.en: Makam Maulana Malik Ibrahim is in Gresik, Jawa Timur. Maulana Malik Ibrahim is buried in Gapurosukolilo, Gresik, and is often described as the earliest figure of the Wali Songo tradition. His origin is debated, and the firmest evidence about him is the inscription on his tombstone.

summary.id: Makam Sunan Drajat berada di Paciran, Jawa Timur. Sunan Drajat, putra Sunan Ampel, dikenang berdakwah di pesisir utara Lamongan dengan kepedulian sosial. Kompleks makamnya di Desa Drajat, Paciran, memiliki museum dan merupakan situs arkeologi Islam yang telah dikaji sejak awal abad ke-20.
summary.en: Makam Sunan Drajat is in Paciran, Jawa Timur. Sunan Drajat, a son of Sunan Ampel, is remembered for preaching on Lamongan's north coast with a strong social concern. His tomb complex in Drajat village, Paciran, includes a museum and has been studied as an Islamic archaeological site since the early 20th century.

details.en: Visiting etiquette: Dress modestly and quietly, follow the management's guidance, and respect pilgrims who are praying. The site serves as a pilgrimage place and also has historical and educational value.

summary.id: Makam Sunan Bonang berada di Tuban, Jawa Timur. Sunan Bonang dikenal sebagai putra Sunan Ampel yang berbasis di Tuban dan dikaitkan dengan naskah suluk serta tradisi dakwah melalui seni. Makamnya di Tuban adalah yang paling sering diziarahi, meski ada klaim lokasi lain.
summary.en: Makam Sunan Bonang is in Tuban, Jawa Timur. Sunan Bonang is remembered as a son of Sunan Ampel who was based in Tuban and is associated with Sufi suluk texts and arts-based preaching. His tomb in Tuban is the most visited, though other sites are also claimed.

details.id: Etika berkunjung: Berpakaian sopan dan menutup aurat, menjaga ketenangan, dan mengikuti arahan juru kunci atau pengelola. Aktivitas yang umum diamati di lokasi adalah membaca Al-Qur'an, Yasin, dan tahlil di pendopo, serta salat berjamaah di Masjid Astana (detik.com). Hormati peziarah yang sedang berdoa.
details.en: Visiting etiquette: Dress modestly, keep quiet, and follow the caretaker's or management's guidance. Commonly observed activities are Qur'an reading, Yasin, and tahlil in the pavilion, and congregational prayer at Masjid Astana (detik.com). Respect pilgrims who are praying.

summary.id: Astana Sunan Gunung Jati berada di Cirebon (Desa Astana, Kecamatan Gunung Jati), Jawa Barat. Syarif Hidayatullah, dikenal sebagai Sunan Gunung Jati, adalah tokoh Wali Songo yang dalam tradisi dan literatur dikaitkan dengan berdirinya kekuasaan Islam di Cirebon dan Banten. Ia dimakamkan di kompleks Astana Gunung Sembung, Cirebon.
summary.en: Astana Sunan Gunung Jati is in Cirebon (Desa Astana, Kecamatan Gunung Jati), Jawa Barat. Syarif Hidayatullah, known as Sunan Gunung Jati, is a Wali Songo figure linked in tradition and literature to the rise of Islamic rule in Cirebon and Banten. He is buried in the Astana Gunung Sembung complex in Cirebon.

details.id: Etika berkunjung: Kompleks adalah makam keraton yang aktif sebagai tempat ziarah. Berpakaian sopan dan ikuti arahan juru kunci dan abdi dalem. Dokumentasi dilarang di area privat menurut sebuah skripsi.
details.en: Visiting etiquette: The complex is an active royal burial site and pilgrimage place. Dress modestly and follow the guidance of the caretaker and abdi dalem. Photography in private areas is prohibited according to a thesis.

summary.id: Kampung Kemasan berada di Gresik, Jawa Timur. Kampung rumah saudagar pribumi dengan arsitektur yang memadukan gaya Tionghoa, kolonial Belanda, dan tata ruang Jawa.
summary.en: Kampung Kemasan is in Gresik, Jawa Timur. A neighbourhood of indigenous merchants' houses blending Chinese and Dutch colonial styles with Javanese layouts.

details.id: Etika berkunjung: Hormati warga setempat: sebagian bangunan adalah rumah yang masih dihuni. Minta izin sebelum memotret orang atau memasuki halaman pribadi.
details.en: Visiting etiquette: Respect local residents: some buildings are lived-in homes. Ask permission before photographing people or entering private yards.
